scope: Week7 selection module only; fresh review after runtime loss
review_findings: All unavailable point/interval and pipeline-error records contribute to a source union; multiple method failures retain their separate failure records without duplicating source selection.
Accepted extrema are per estimator and per metric, restricted to interval-valid records with finite metrics. Cell-ID then replication tie breaking is independent of input record order.
Completed input verification composes provenance, audit fingerprint, scientific metadata digest, figure hashes, full archive byte map and a bound visual-review record.
Registered E1/E2 inputs are required before source reading. Experiment labels remain distinct for matching cell/rep indices; unresolved headline rows are retained without pooling.

The fixed exploratory designs preserve n/q/CV/truth, seeds20261007 and20261009, R10000 andR2000, twelve actual floor IDs and four potential anchor groups. Validation uses seed+1000000 only with its own scope/name and specified small R.
The selector consumes already audited sealed raw records; it does not replace upstream full-Cartesian-key/type validation or independently recalculate their numerical inference.
published_input_check_scope: read-only seal/dependency verification; source.sample patched to fail if regeneration attempted; root bytes unchanged
fixture_scope: small constructed metadata/row fixtures only; no exploratory results or scientific visual-review claims
recovery_statement: This is newly executed evidence for current reconstructed bytes, not a recreated copy of the lost prior review or its 971-test result.
remaining_gates: Other Week7 modules, full-suite validation, code/protocol publication, full science and result review remain separate.
